Title: User Registration and Authentication
Description / Traceability: Allow users to register with name, email, password, and log in securely. Supports UC-04, UC-05, TC-01, TC-02.

Title: Password Hashing and Storage Protection
Description / Traceability: Passwords shall be hashed using secure one-way hashing (e.g. bcrypt/argon2) and never stored as plain text. Supports NFR-03, TC-11.

Title: Authentication and Role-Based Authorization Guard
Description / Traceability: Protected endpoints require JWT/session authentication and role-based checks (Visitor, Attendee, Organizer, Admin). Supports NFR-04, TC-02, TC-09.

Title: Secure Session Management and Token Expiry
Description / Traceability: Reject expired or unauthorized tokens/sessions safely and require re-login. Supports TC-16.

Title: Event Browsing, Search, and Category Filtering
Description / Traceability: Allow visitors and users to browse public events, search by title/keywords, and filter by categories/date. Supports UC-01, UC-02, TC-03.

Title: Event Details View
Description / Traceability: Display event details including title, date, time, location, description, organizer, and capacity. Supports UC-03, TC-03.

Title: Organizer Event Creation, Editing, and Cancellation
Description / Traceability: Allow authenticated organizers to create new events, update details of their events, and cancel events. Supports UC-11, UC-12, UC-13, TC-08.

Title: Event Capacity Configuration and Participant List View
Description / Traceability: Allow organizers to define maximum event capacity and view registered participants. Supports UC-14, UC-15, TC-08.

Title: Event Registration and Full-Capacity Rejection
Description / Traceability: Allow authenticated attendees to register for an event; automatically reject registration when capacity is full. Supports UC-06, TC-04, TC-05.

Title: Duplicate Registration Prevention and Registration Cancellation
Description / Traceability: Prevent a user from registering twice for the same event and allow attendees to cancel existing registrations. Supports UC-06, UC-07, TC-06, TC-07.

Title: Attendee Registered Events Dashboard
Description / Traceability: Allow registered users to view a list of all events they have registered for. Supports UC-08, TC-07.

Title: Data Consistency for Event Capacities and Registrations
Description / Traceability: Maintain atomic registration counts and transactional consistency under concurrent registrations and cancellations. Supports TC-13.

Title: Modular Client-Server Component Architecture
Description / Traceability: Implement layered architecture: React.js UI, Express.js REST API layer, isolated Data Access/DB layer. Supports TC-14, 09_Software_Architecture.

Title: Input Validation and Sanitization at API Boundary
Description / Traceability: Validate all inbound payloads (schemas, types, bounds) on client and server to prevent malformed or injection inputs. Supports TC-16.

Title: Responsive and Usable User Interface
Description / Traceability: Ensure all client views are clean, intuitive, and mobile/desktop responsive. Supports TC-12.

Title: Event Listing Page Performance Optimization (< 3s)
Description / Traceability: Optimize queries, pagination, and payload size so event listing loads in under 3 seconds under normal load. Supports TC-10.

Title: Organizer Event Announcements and Updates Broadcast
Description / Traceability: Allow organizers to send announcements/updates to registered participants and attendees to view notifications. Supports UC-10, UC-16, TC-17.

Title: Organizer Registration Reports Generation
Description / Traceability: Allow organizers to generate and export summary and participant registration reports for their events. Supports UC-20, TC-15.

Title: Administrator Management of Users, Organizers, and Events
Description / Traceability: Allow administrators to view and manage users and organizers, and moderate/remove inappropriate events. Supports UC-17, UC-18, UC-19, TC-09, TC-18.

Title: Administrative Privilege and Route Protection
Description / Traceability: Strictly restrict administrative routes, moderation actions, and user privilege elevation to verified admin accounts. Supports TC-09, TC-18.

Title: Registration Processing Latency Optimization (< 2s)
Description / Traceability: Tune registration endpoints, index lookups, and transaction boundaries to process valid registrations within 2 seconds. Supports TC-10.
